content.en_US:
Obtained from either combining [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] with [[chlorine gas|Chlorine Gas]] or by [[breeding|RBMK Irradiation Channel]] [[chlorinated petroleum wax|Chlorinated Petroleum Wax]]. Both methods of producing high-performance solvent require a RBMK reactor to produce due to the prerequisite of [[bismuth|Bismuth]] for [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]]. High-Performance Solvent is primarily used for advanced [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]] or the production of [[fullerene solution|Fullerene Solution]] for [[crystalline fullerite|Crystalline Fullerite]].
